title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking! — Episode1 A Wonderful Invitation

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Where did my phone go...?
Ah, it was hiding under my pillow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We're practicing in SEKAI today, but I have a bit of time on my hands. I think I'll head over early and practice on my own until then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? Saki's calling me...?
I wonder why...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <H-Hello, Toya? It's been so long!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Good morning, Saki.
How can I help you today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <So, there's something I wanna talk to you about. Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I have singing practice later today, but we're not meeting for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Great! Then...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Have you already heard about the dinner party?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, my mom mentioned that to me. Your parents are coming over to my house this Sunday, correct?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that! Me and Tsukasa got really excited when we heard the news since the last time we had dinner together was forever ago...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <But our dad said that it's gonna be adults only, so we can't go...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
I suppose they have some business they'd like to discuss, but I was also looking forward to having dinner with you and Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Me too! But, thank goodness! I knew you'd understand!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <So, after talking it over with Tsukasa yesterday, we began thinking about having our own dinner party.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <How about it? Wanna come over the Sunday after next?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To your house?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yup! Oh, but...it's totally okay if you don't want to...! To be honest, we haven't gotten anything ready yet!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The Sunday after next...?
I should be free that day, so I'd be more than happy to come over.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Really? Woohoo!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Oh, I need to tell Tsukasa the good news! He won't know what to do with himself!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for inviting me.
I'll be looking forward to the party.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Same! Get ready to be absolutely blown away! Anyway, see you that Sunday! Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, see you then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A dinner party with Tsukasa and Saki at their house...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's been quite a while...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I still remember very vividly how I always seemed to feel at home over there whenever I visited...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Because I never felt all that comfortable in my own home back then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It happens very rarely these days, but I definitely looked forward to being sent to their house when my parents were busy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I look forward to seeing them again...
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm still a bit early...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For now, I should just head over. We agreed to meet at MEIKO's place as usual...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya, hello.
Are you here to practice today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we decided to have practice over here today because it's supposed to rain this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you have plans to go somewhere today, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, to where Rin is.
I promised her that we'd practice singing together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
Wait, what about the cafe...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, about that...
I'm lending it out to KAITO and Len for the day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Lending it out?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, MEIKO!
Can we borrow your kitchen for like a day?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure, but... If it's just the kitchen, you can use it right now if you like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Now would be bad...
We need it when no one else is around. In other words, we need the whole cafe to ourselves!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, so... That's a secret!
Please, I beg you...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: ...is what happened.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's an interesting request...
Does that mean they're making something they don't want others to see?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I suspect so.
I mean, I can sort of guess just based on the time of year...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
You can?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case...
This means we probably shouldn't try going inside today, yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: More specifically, An and Kohane probably are the ones who shouldn't be going in.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You and Akito may actually be welcome.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll know once you get there. Hehe. In any case, have fun during practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something they don't want MEIKO and the others to see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What in the world could Len and KAITO be making in there...?
